en: The sky is dark. Bunny yawns a big yawn. Haaaa.
Bunny brushes her teeth. Brush, brush, brush.
Bunny puts on her soft pyjamas with stars.
Papa reads a little book. Bunny snuggles close.
Lights off. Goodnight, Bunny. Shhh, shhh.
id: Langit sudah gelap. Kelinci menguap lebar. Haaaa.
Kelinci menyikat gigi. Sikat, sikat, sikat.
Kelinci memakai piyama lembut bergambar bintang.
Ayah membacakan buku kecil. Kelinci meringkuk dekat Ayah.
Lampu dimatikan. Selamat tidur, Kelinci. Ssst, ssst.

readAloudNotes.en: Do a big slow yawn and stretch your arms. Invite your child to copy.
readAloudNotes.id: Menguaplah pelan dan lebar sambil meregangkan lengan. Ajak anak menirukan.

readAloudNotes.en: Pretend to brush your teeth with one finger.
readAloudNotes.id: Pura-pura menyikat gigi dengan satu jari.

readAloudNotes.en: Touch your child's sleeve or tummy as if putting on pyjamas.
readAloudNotes.id: Sentuh lengan baju atau perut anak seolah memakaikan piyama.

readAloudNotes.en: Pull your child in for a cuddle and turn a pretend page.
readAloudNotes.id: Peluk anak dan buka halaman pura-pura.

readAloudNotes.en: Whisper the last line very softly and put a finger to your lips.
readAloudNotes.id: Bisikkan kalimat terakhir sangat pelan dan letakkan jari di bibir.

sequenceCards.en: Card 1: a bunny yawning under a dark sky
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 1: kelinci menguap di bawah langit gelap

sequenceCards.en: Card 2: a bunny with a toothbrush
Card 3: a bunny in star pyjamas
Card 4: a bunny reading a book with Papa
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 4: kelinci membaca buku bersama Ayah

sequenceCards.en: Card 5: a bunny asleep with the light off
sequenceCards.id: Kartu 5: kelinci tidur dengan lampu mati

objectives.en: Listens to and retells a bedtime routine in order.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan dan menceritakan kembali urutan sebelum tidur.

objectives.en: Joins in with actions for each step.
objectives.id: Ikut melakukan gerakan untuk setiap langkah.

meaning.en: opening your mouth wide when you are sleepy
soft clothes we wear to sleep
to cuddle up close and cosy
meaning.id: meringkuk dekat-dekat supaya hangat dan nyaman

connection.en: Brushing teeth and a calm routine help our bodies rest well.
connection.id: Menyikat gigi dan rutinitas yang tenang membantu tubuh beristirahat dengan baik.

discussionPrompts.en: What do you do before you sleep?
discussionPrompts.id: Apa yang kamu lakukan sebelum tidur?

discussionPrompts.en: Which pyjamas do you like best?
discussionPrompts.id: Piyama mana yang paling kamu suka?

offlineActivity.en: Tonight, tell the story again as you do each step of your own bedtime routine, saying 'just like Bunny' at each step.
offlineActivity.id: Malam ini, ceritakan lagi kisahnya sambil menjalani setiap langkah rutinitas tidur anak, dan ucapkan 'seperti Kelinci' di setiap langkah.
